mapper.sql: D.DOC_ID AS docId, D.SUIT_ID AS suitId, D.DOC_KIND_CD AS docKindCd, DK.CODE_NM AS docKindNm, D.DOC_TITL AS docTitl, D.DOC_MEMO AS docMemo, D.ATCH_FILE_ID AS atchFileId, D.APP_STS_CD AS appStsCd, AP.CODE_NM AS appStsNm, D.APP_USER_ID AS appUserId, D.APP_USER_NM AS appUserNm, D.APP_DT AS appDt, D.APP_OPINION AS appOpinion, D.REG_USER_ID AS regUserId, RU.USER_NM AS regUserNm, D.REG_DT AS regDt, S.COURT_NM AS courtNm, S.CASE_NO AS caseNo, S.CASE_NM AS caseNm

FROM LAW_SUIT_DOC D JOIN LAW_SUIT S ON S.SUIT_ID = D.SUIT_ID AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE DK ON DK.CODE_ID = 'LAW_DOC_KIND' AND DK.CODE = D.DOC_KIND_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE AP ON AP.CODE_ID = 'LAW_DOC_APP_STATUS' AND AP.CODE = D.APP_STS_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNEMPLYRINFO RU ON RU.EMPLYR_ID = D.REG_USER_ID
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT D.ATCH_FILE_ID
WHERE D.ATCH_FILE_ID IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(D.ATCH_FILE_ID) IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE LAW_SUIT_DOC SET DOC_KIND_CD = #{docKindCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DOC_TITL = #{docTitl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DOC_MEMO = #{docMemo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ATCH_FILE_ID = #{atchFileId, jdbcType=CHAR}, APP_STS_CD = 'S001', APP_USER_ID = NULL, APP_USER_NM = NULL, APP_DT = NULL, APP_OPINION = NULL, UPD_USER_ID = #{updUserId}, UPD_DT = #{updDt} WHERE DOC_ID = #{docId}

UPDATE LAW_SUIT_DOC SET APP_STS_CD = #{appStsCd}, APP_USER_ID = #{appUserId}, APP_USER_NM = #{appUserNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, APP_DT = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), APP_OPINION = #{appOpinion, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE DOC_ID = #{docId}
